limitations: Source review does not establish compiled IEEE behavior, full-adapter transport, physical accuracy or performance.
observations: Independent removal of exactly two declaration blocks and two executable insertions recovers the frozen original byte-for-byte.
DP 7FF and QP 7FFF exponent masks are correct and ignore the sign bit.
Same-storage-width integer TRANSFER avoids selecting a high word from a multiword QP value.
Every added floating comparison is dominated by whole-matrix integer finiteness classification.
Only unequal finite lower partners are replaced; upper, diagonal and already-equal signed-zero bytes remain.
All source lines fit the existing 132-column fixed-form compiler setting.
